title: Mtoni water resilience
summary: A fictional East African community plans for a prolonged water shortage.

scripted_events.message: The community reviews the first week's water use.
The school asks how the plan protects learners.
Farmers share an update from the local market.
The clinic reports on its essential water needs.
Community members compare the effects of the plan.
The community reviews the final mission results.

approved_actors.persona: A fictional clinic nurse who explains essential clinic water needs.
approved_actors.rules: Use calm, age-appropriate English. Ask about trade-offs; never prescribe medical care or change simulation values.

approved_actors.persona: A fictional farmer who explains irrigation and crop trade-offs.
approved_actors.rules: Use respectful, age-appropriate English. Do not claim facts absent from the supplied state.

approved_actors.persona: A fictional head teacher who explains school water needs.
approved_actors.rules: Use supportive, age-appropriate English. Ask evidence-based questions and never grade a learner.

learning_objectives: Explain how finite water, infrastructure loss, and sector demands interact.
Compare allocation trade-offs using recorded simulation evidence.
Use a replay to evaluate an alternative plan.

en: Leakage is removed before water reaches the sectors.
Clinic and school minimums affect the remaining allocation.
Compare turn accounting, service levels and unmet demand.
sw: Maji yanayovuja huondolewa kabla ya mgao kwa sekta.
Mahitaji ya kliniki na shule huathiri maji yaliyobaki.
Linganisha hesabu ya zamu, huduma na mahitaji yasiyotimizwa.
